title: HomeBuyer Tip: No BIG PURCHASES TIL AFTER CLOSING
description:
A home purchase is one of the biggest purchases that most people make in their entire lifetime....and if you are using a line of credit/home mortgage, 
🌟WAIT TO BUY ANYTHING ON LOAN UNTIL AFTER SIGNING🌟
No car loans, furniture loans, credit cards....Just WAIT!
